units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:17:2">Cant. R. to I, 17</cite> (ref. to <he>ורהיטנו</he> <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:17:2">ib.</cite>) <he>מקום שהכהנים ר׳ בברותים</he> the place where the priests ran (at service) was laid out with cypresses (ref. to <cite ref="I Kings 6:15">I Kings VI, 15</cite>).

senses.gloss: (denom. of רָהִיט) to lay rafters. Ib. למדה תורה … מקרה … ומַרְהִיט בברותים the text (Cant. l. c.) teaches a practical lesson that man should use cedars for roofing and cypresses for the rafters.
